SELECT result.id AS simulationResultId, simulation.id AS simulationId, simulation.created_by AS createdBy, layout.title AS layoutTitle, simulation.title AS title FROM simulation_results result JOIN simulations simulation ON simulation.id = result.simulation_id JOIN layout_versions layout_version ON layout_version.id = simulation.layout_version_id JOIN layouts layout ON layout.id = layout_version.layout_id WHERE result.id IN
AND simulation.created_by = #{createdBy}
SELECT simulation_result_id AS simulationResultId, metric_type AS metricType, metric_value AS metricValue, unit FROM simulation_metrics WHERE simulation_result_id IN ORDER BY simulation_result_id, id

SELECT simulation_result_id AS simulationResultId, bottleneck_order AS bottleneckOrder, start_time_seconds AS startTimeSeconds, end_time_seconds AS endTimeSeconds, peak_density AS peakDensity, threshold_value AS thresholdValue FROM detected_bottlenecks WHERE simulation_result_id IN ORDER BY simulation_result_id, bottleneck_order
